comments.body: i should be able to bring this up but putting a reminder here to get temp check on coupling hoodi and mainnet releases for fusaka together, or if clients prefer a different configuration

> Gas limit testing updates

Besu update in case there is noone on the call with latest context...

TL;DR: this list is up to date (thanks Kamil) https://github.com/NethermindEth/eth-perf-research/blob/main/README.md#-current-resultsfindings

- No EcRecover issues
- Now: unblock 60MGas by looking at the newly discovered EEST opcode benchmark issues.
- Next: unblocking 60MGas+ by improving EcAdd, for which we have some improvements that need productionising, but is now less urgent than the opcodes.
- Also looking at general improvements that should impact opcodes/evm performance overall.

We have four engineers looking at this full time, maybe adding a fifth this week.
More return from vacation soon as well.
